name: Linear & Quadratic Inequalities
name_zh: 一元一次及一元二次不等式
roadmap: ROADMAP: Master the 'Golden Rules' of sign reversal first. Progress from simple linear inequalities to compound conditions (AND / OR). Finally, master quadratic inequalities and graphical systems for Section B optimization.
roadmap_zh: 進度路線：首先掌握等號變向的「黃金律」。從簡單的一元一次不等式進階到複合條件（AND 與 OR）。最後，精通一元二次不等式及平面圖像系統，以應對乙部的最優化題目。

concepts.name: Rule 1: Addition & Subtraction
concepts.formula: a < b \implies a + c < b + c
concepts.key_takeaway: Adding or subtracting the same value never changes the inequality sign.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 在不等式兩邊同時加上或減去同一個數，不等號的方向保持不變。

concepts.name: Rule 2: Multiply by Positive
concepts.formula: a < b \text{ and } c > 0 \implies ac < bc
concepts.key_takeaway: Multiplying or dividing by a positive number maintains the inequality sign.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 當兩邊同時乘以或除以一個正數時，不等號的方向保持不變。

concepts.name: Rule 3: The Golden Rule (Negative)
concepts.name_zh: 規則三：負數乘除「黃金律」
concepts.formula: a < b \text{ and } c < 0 \implies ac > bc
concepts.key_takeaway: IMPORTANT: When multiplying or dividing by a NEGATIVE number, you MUST reverse the inequality sign.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 重要提示：當兩邊同時乘以或除以一個負數時，必須將不等號的方向反轉。

learning_modules.title: Compound & Quadratic
learning_modules.title_zh: 複合與一元二次不等式

concepts.name: AND vs OR (Compound)
concepts.formula: x > a \cap x < b \text{ vs } x < a \cup x > b
concepts.key_takeaway: AND requires BOTH conditions to be true (the overlap region). OR requires AT LEAST one condition to be true (the union region).
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 「且」(AND) 要求兩個條件同時成立（重疊區域）；「或」(OR) 要求至少一個條件成立（聯集區域）。

concepts.name: Quadratic Strategy
concepts.key_takeaway: For a positive leading coefficient: - The 'less than 0' region is between roots. - The 'greater than 0' region is outside roots.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 當首項係數為正時： - 「小於 0」的解位於兩根之間。 - 「大於 0」的解位於兩根之外。

learning_modules.title: DSE Section B: Optimization
learning_modules.title_zh: 乙部課題：線性規劃最優化

concepts.name: Linear Programming
concepts.key_takeaway: Identify the feasible region. Maximum or minimum values of the objective function usually occur at the vertices (corners) of this region.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 首先確定可行解區域。目標函數的最大值或最小值通常出現在該區域的頂點（角點）上。
